validated_author_data_path.scope: These are static admission/retention conclusions for a unique valid content identity, registered NORMAL/target data, valid remaining fields, no additional plugin/override and normal prerequisite data order. ordered_expected_prefix: Ordinary outer METRONOME PP changes5→4; outer user/global use history is recorded as METRONOME.
